notes: STORY 2.5 PRECISION FIXTURE, plus the second measured layer false positive.
A `console.log(JSON.stringify(summary))` in a developer's own CLI was filed
because the resource's floor came from a CRON SCHEDULER resolve-layer surface.
Two independent defects in one row: the floor crossed a layer boundary (2.4),
and stdout was treated as egress to an untrusted caller (2.5). Six of 49 sampled
R-rule false positives were this shape or the `0600`-write-to-own-home shape
below. Neither sink has a caller who could have been asked for a credential.
Run the same inventory with `destination` stripped and it fires — see
tests/test-egress.sh, which does exactly that so this silence is not vacuous.

guarded_paths.enforced_gate: none — console.log to the invoking developer's own stdout
none — writeFileSync(mode 0o600) under the device's own XDG state dir
